Common.name: Ancient Gear
Common.desc: If you control an "Ancient Gear", you can Special Summon this card (from your hand) in face-up Attack Position.

Common.name: Ancient Gear Beast
Common.desc: Cannot be Special Summoned. If this card attacks, your opponent cannot activate any Spell/Trap Cards until the end of the Damage Step. Negate the effects of an opponent's monster destroyed by battle with this card (including in the Graveyard).

Common.name: Ancient Gear Cannon
Common.desc: You can Tribute this card; inflict 500 damage to your opponent, and if you do, neither player can activate Trap Cards during the Battle Phase of this turn.

Common.name: Ancient Gear Castle
Common.desc: All "Ancient Gear" monsters gain 300 ATK. Each time a monster is Normal Summoned/Set, place 1 counter on this card. If you Tribute Summon an "Ancient Gear" monster face-up, you can Tribute this card instead, if the number of its counters is equal to or greater than the number of required Tribute(s).

Common.name: Ancient Gear Drill
Common.desc: If you control an "Ancient Gear" monster: Discard 1 card; Set 1 Spell Card directly from your Deck. This turn, that Spell Card cannot be activated.

Common.name: Ancient Gear Engineer
Common.desc: Negate any Trap effects that target this card, and if you do, destroy that Trap Card. If this card attacks, your opponent cannot activate any Spell/Trap Cards until the end of the Damage Step. At the end of the Damage Step, if this card attacked: Target 1 Spell/Trap Card your opponent controls; destroy that target.

Common.name: Ancient Gear Explosive
Common.desc: Target 1 "Ancient Gear" monster you control; destroy it, and if you do, inflict damage to your opponent equal to half its original ATK.

Common.name: Ancient Gear Factory
Common.desc: Reveal 1 Level 5 or higher "Ancient Gear" monster from your hand, then banish a number of "Ancient Gear" monsters from your Graveyard, whose combined Levels are double the revealed monster's, and if you do, if you Normal Summon the revealed monster this turn, you must Normal Smmon it without Tributing.

Common.name: Ancient Gear Fist
Common.desc: Equip only to an "Ancient Gear" monster. At the end of the Damage Step, if the equipped monster battled a monster and is still on the field: Destroy the monster it battled.

Common.name: Ancient Gear Gadjiltron Chimera
Common.desc:
This card gains the appropriate effects if you Normal Summon it by Tributing these monsters.
● Green Gadget: This card gains 300 ATK.
● Red Gadget: If this card inflicts battle damage to your opponent by a direct attack: Inflict 500 damage to your opponent.
● Yellow Gadget: If this card destroys an opponent's monster by battle: Inflict 700 damage to your opponent.

Common.name: Ancient Gear Golem
Common.desc: Cannot be Special Summoned. If this card attacks, your opponent cannot activate any Spell/Trap Cards until the end of the Damage Step. If this card attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage.

Common.name: Ancient Gear Soldier
Common.desc: If this card attacks, your opponent cannot activate any Spell/Trap Cards until the end of the Damage Step.

Common.name: Ancient Gear Tank
Common.desc: Equip only to an "Ancient Gear" monster. It gains 600 ATK. When this card is destroyed and sent to the Graveyard: Inflict 600 damage to your opponent.

Common.name: Ancient Gear Workshop
Common.desc: Target 1 "Ancient Gear" monster in your Graveyard; add that target to your hand.

Common.name: Boot-Up Soldier - Dread Dynamo
Common.desc: While you control a "Gadget" monster, this card gains 2000 ATK.

Common.name: Cannon Soldier
Common.desc: You can Tribute 1 monster; inflict 500 damage to your opponent.

Common.name: Covering Fire
Common.desc: During the Damage Step, while an opponent's monster is attacking a monster you control: Target 1 other face-up monster you control; your attacked monster gains ATK equal to that target's ATK during the Damage Step only.

Common.name: Enemy Controller
Common.desc:
Activate 1 of these effects.
● Target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls; change that target's battle position.
● Tribute 1 monster, then target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls; take control of that target until the End Phase.

Common.name: Gear Golem the Moving Fortress
Common.desc: Once per turn, during your Main Phase 1: You can pay 800 Life Points; this card can attack your opponent directly this turn.

Common.name: Green Gadget
Common.desc: When this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can add 1 "Red Gadget" from your Deck to your hand.

Common.name: Heavy Mech Support Platform
Common.desc: Once per turn, you can either: Target 1 Machine monster you control; equip this card to that target, OR: Unequip this card and Special Summon it. A monster equipped with this card gains 500 ATK/DEF, also if the equipped monster would be destroyed by battle or card effect, destroy this card instead.

Common.name: Heavy Storm
Common.desc: Destroy all Spell and Trap Cards on the field.

Common.name: Limiter Removal
Common.desc: Double the ATK of all Machine monsters you currently control, until the end of this turn. During the End Phase of this turn, destroy those monsters.

Common.name: Machine Duplication
Common.desc: Target 1 Machine monster you control with 500 or less ATK; Special Summon up to 2 monsters from your Deck with the same name as that face-up monster.

Common.name: Mechanicalchaser
Common.desc: A hunter that relentlessly pursues its target by order of the Machine King.

Common.name: Micro Ray
Common.desc: Target 1 face-up monster on the field; that target's DEF becomes 0 until the end of this turn.

Common.name: Mystical Space Typhoon
Common.desc: Target 1 Spell/Trap on the field; destroy that target.

Common.name: Pot of Avarice
Common.desc: Target 5 monsters in your GY; shuffle all 5 into the Deck, then draw 2 cards.

Common.name: Rare Metalmorph
Common.desc: Activate this card by targeting 1 Machine-Type monster on the field; it gains 500 ATK. Once, negate a Spell effect that targets that monster. When that monster leaves the field, destroy this card.

Common.name: Red Gadget
Common.desc: When this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can add 1 "Yellow Gadget" from your Deck to your hand.

Common.name: Roll Out!
Common.desc: Target 1 Union monster in your Graveyard; equip that target to a monster you control that would be an appropriate target for that Union monster's effect.

Common.name: Sakuretsu Armor
Common.desc: When an opponent's monster declares an attack: Target the attacking monster; destroy that target.

Common.name: Stronghold the Moving Fortress
Common.desc: Special Summon this card in Defense Position as an Effect Monster (Machine/EARTH/Level 4/ATK 0/DEF 2000). (This card is also still a Trap.) While you control "Green Gadget", "Red Gadget", and "Yellow Gadget", this card gains 3000 ATK.

Common.name: Ultimate Offering
Common.desc: During your Main Phase or your opponent's Battle Phase: You can pay 500 Life Points; immediately after this effect resolves, Normal Summon/Set 1 monster.

Common.name: Weapon Change
Common.desc: Once during each of your Standby Phases: You can pay 700 Life Points, then target 1 Warrior or Machine-Type monster you control; switch the current ATK and DEF of that target until the end of your opponent's next turn.

Common.name: Yellow Gadget
Common.desc: When this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can add 1 "Green Gadget" from your Deck to your hand.

Ultra Rare.desc:
If this card attacks, your opponent cannot activate any Spell/Trap Cards until the end of the Damage Step. This card gains the appropriate effects if you Normal Summon it by Tributing these monsters.
● Green Gadget: If this card attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage to your opponent. 
● Red Gadget: If this card inflicts battle damage to your opponent: Inflict 400 damage to your opponent. 
● Yellow Gadget: If this card destroys an opponent's monster by battle: Inflict 600 damage to your opponent.
